knowledge:
- key_parameters: gwas_data and LD in assign_SNPs_to_genes (requires GFF file, feature types, distance window, R^2 threshold, and number of cores) ;; find_pathway_significance (requires genes data, pathways file, minimum number of genes per pathway, effect direction, number of permutations, and number of cores) ;; plot_pathways (requires rugplots data, selection metric, threshold, effect direction, and output directory)
- alternatives: None mentioned (uses TASSEL for upstream GWAS/LD generation and QVALUE for FDR correction)
- when_to_use: When performing metabolic pathway enrichment analysis using GWAS association statistics, allele effects, linkage disequilibrium data, GFF annotations, and a pathway-to-gene mapping file.
- pitfalls: Non-biallelic markers are dropped during GWAS data loading ;; LD chromosome names must match the GFF annotation's chromosome column (first column) ;; Gene names in the pathways file must match the gene names in the GFF file ;; Incomplete cases in LD data are dropped.

workflows.name: gwas_pathway_enrichment
workflows.intent: Run a complete GWAS-based metabolic pathway enrichment analysis from raw TASSEL outputs and GFF annotations to pathway significance plotting.
workflows.stages: 1. Load GWAS association and effects data using load_GWAS_data ;; 2. Load Linkage Disequilibrium (LD) data using load_LD ;; 3. Assign SNPs to genes based on LD blocks and physical distance using assign_SNPs_to_genes ;; 4. Calculate pathway enrichment scores and significance using find_pathway_significance ;; 5. Plot enrichment rugplots for significant pathways using plot_pathways
workflows.code:
demo_association_file = system.file("extdata", "association.txt.xz", 
                                    package = "PAST", mustWork = TRUE)
demo_effects_file = system.file("extdata", "effects.txt.xz", 
                                package = "PAST", mustWork = TRUE)
demo_LD_file = system.file("extdata", "LD.txt.xz", 
                           package = "PAST", mustWork = TRUE)
demo_genes_file = system.file("extdata", "genes.gff", 
                              package = "PAST", mustWork = TRUE)
demo_pathways_file = system.file("extdata", "pathways.txt.xz", 
                                 package = "PAST", mustWork = TRUE)
gwas_data <- load_GWAS_data(demo_association_file, 
                            demo_effects_file)
LD <- load_LD(demo_LD_file)
genes <-assign_SNPs_to_genes(gwas_data, 
                             LD, 
                             demo_genes_file,
                             c("gene"),
                             1000, 
                             0.8, 
                             2)
rugplots_data <- find_pathway_significance(genes, 
                                           demo_pathways_file, 
                                           5,
                                           "increasing", 
                                           1000, 
                                           2)
plot_pathways(rugplots_data, 
              "pvalue", 
              0.02, 
              "increasing", 
              tempdir())
